将你的一项属性增加6点（最高20）。降低两项不同的属性各2点。

You made a bargain with shadow Fey, gaining a gift at a terrible cost. Choose one benefit and drawback below, or discuss another option with your GM:

Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and always make ability checks using it with advantage. Choose a second skill; you always make ability checks using that skill with disadvantage.
You no longer need to eat or breathe to survive, and can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours. You gain one level of Exhaustion that cannot be removed by any magical or nonmagical means.
Halve your current base speed. Gain a Fly, Swim, or Climb Speed equal to that halved base speed.
Increase one ability score by 6, to a maximum of 20. Decrease two other, different ability scores by 2 each.
At dawn each day, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution score. You can no longer expend Hit Dice to heal during Short Rests.

As part of that Bonus Action, you can use it to manipulate an object, open or close a door or container, or pick up or set down a Tiny object. The pseudopod has no sensory organs and cannot attack, activate magic items, or lift more than 10 pounds.

target:

When the trance ends, the token is harmlessly destroyed.
